name: Glenoid Fracture
definition: Fracture involving the glenoid articular surface or rim, often associated with shoulder dislocation or high-energy trauma.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are initial; CT is important for articular involvement and surgical planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Large displaced articular or unstable rim fractures may require fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern fracture assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture involving the glenoid articular surface or rim, often associated with shoulder dislocation or high-energy trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
